description:
15 Salthill presents a truly exceptional opportunity to acquire a spectacular duplex residence that has been meticulously refurbished to the very highest standards, all while enjoying uninterrupted, panoramic views across Dublin Bay. This remarkable home has undergone an extensive programme of renovation and upgrading, resulting in a luxurious, light-filled interior that effortlessly combines contemporary elegance with timeless design.

Extending to beautifully proportioned accommodation, the property is bathed in natural light throughout and is further enhanced by three private balconies, perfectly positioned to capture breathtaking vistas stretching from Howth Head across the bay to Dun Laoghaire Harbour and Seapoint. Every element of the interior has been carefully curated, with high-quality finishes including rich solid wood flooring, bespoke timber panelling and a stunning, high-end kitchen by Blackrock Kitchens, complete with premium appliances and sleek silestone worktops.

The main living level is ideally designed for both everyday living and entertaining, comprising a generous dining room, guest w.c. and an outstanding living room where dramatic windows frame the ever-changing seascape beyond. A particular highlight is the large south-facing terrace accessed from the kitchen, a true suntrap that enjoys all-day sunshine and provides the perfect setting for al fresco dining and relaxation.

Upstairs, the sense of quality and space continues with three well-appointed bedrooms. Two bedrooms overlook the beautifully maintained landscaped gardens, while the principal suite to the rear is nothing short of breathtaking, featuring a luxurious en suite and picture windows that perfectly capture the stunning coastal views. A beautifully finished family bathroom completes the accommodation at this level.

The location is second to none, positioned just a short five-minute stroll from the ever popular bathing spot at Seapoint, the DART and the charming village of Monkstown, renowned for its array of boutique shops, cafés, restaurants and bars. Both Blackrock and Dun Laoghaire are within easy reach, offering an excellent selection of retail and leisure amenities. The area is also home to a number of highly regarded schools and sports clubs, while Dun Laoghaire Harbour provides a wealth of marine and recreational activities. Dublin City Centre is approximately seven miles away, with superb transport links including the nearby Salthill & Monkstown DART station, numerous bus routes and the Aircoach offering direct access to Dublin Airport.
